Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer
Team: Platform
Location: Remote (US)
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: $140,000 - $180,000 per year

About Lumen
Lumen builds payment infrastructure for marketplaces. We raised $40M in a Series B last spring and
now process over $2 billion a year for 1,200 customers.

What you'll do
- Design and ship services in Go and Postgres that move money safely
- Own the reliability of the ledger service, including on-call
- Mentor two mid-level engineers

What you'll need
- 6+ years of backend engineering experience
- Production experience with Go, Rust or Java
- Strong grounding in relational databases and SQL
- Experience operating services on AWS or GCP

Nice to have
- Experience with payments or ledger systems
- Kubernetes experience

Benefits
- $1,500 learning budget per year
- Health, dental and vision from day one
- 401(k) with a 4% match
